name: Shricon Industries Limited
about: Shricon Industries Limited engages in the online retail of neutraceutics, books, labs and science equipment, toys, home décor, handicraft, and other products in India. The company offers its products across online platforms, including Amazon, Flipkart, eBay, and Walmart. It also provides real estate services. The company was formerly known as Bharwaney Builders and Leasing Limited and changed its name to Shricon Industries Limited in January 1995. Shricon Industries Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Kota, India.
